description: Create a Chat channel attached to a specific Space, Folder or List (ClickUp Chat v3), so the conversation is tied to that location. Returns the created channel.

name.description: Optional channel name. Defaults to the location's name.

parent_id.description: ID of the location to attach the channel to (a Space, Folder or List id).

parent_type.description: Type of the location given in `parent_id`.

team_id.description: Team/Workspace ID. Falls back to CLICKUP_TEAM_ID when omitted.

visibility.description: PUBLIC = anyone in the Workspace can join; PRIVATE = invite only.

name: create_chat_channel_on_location
